description: Sankey chart by Powerviz is a flow diagram that visualizes the proportional movement of data, resources, or processes between different categories or stages, using weighted flows to represent the magnitude of connections. The advanced Sankey Chart includes vertical and horizontal charts, adding multiple levels, highlighting and moving nodes, fill patterns, 30+ color palettes, conditional formatting, ranking, sorting, import/export, and many more. Check out the live demo here. To access all advanced settings features, click the gear "⚙️" icon in the top-right corner. Key Feature Highlights: Chart Option – 2 in 1 visual, switch easily between vertical and horizontal Sankey chart. Node Customizations – Options to adjust node appearance, spacing, visibility, and interactions for better readability and visual clarity in Sankey charts. Multi-Level Sankey – Add multiple levels to your chart, enabling clear visualization of complex flows across various hierarchical stages. Labels – Add Data labels and Header labels to improve readability. Image Labels – Add dynamic image URLs as labels inside or outside to enhance the visual representation. Data Colors – Offers 30+ color palettes, including color-blind safe mode for better accessibility. Fill Pattern – Create patterns by selecting from a diverse range of options or uploading your own.
